_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fsi_xfem#3. The rule (the Nitsche penalty must be tuned) holds, but the entry named no 4C key and described symptoms 4C never prints. The key is NIT_STAB_FAC in XFLUID DYNAMIC/STABILIZATION, a dimensionless factor with default 35 -- the mu/h_cut scaling is applied internally through VISC_STAB_TRACE_ESTIMATE and VISC_STAB_HK, so the entry's 'gamma_N in [10,100]*mu/h_cut' is the right magnitude for the wrong quantity. On the upstream monolithic deck xfsi_3D_boxes, NIT_STAB_FAC 0.001 and 1e12 each leave the run healthy -- Newton converges, 'Checking results of 7 tests' is reached -- and each fails six of the seven pinned values. No interface-jump or condition-number diagnostic is ever printed. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the low arm: leave NIT_STAB_FAC at its default. LO_RESULT_FAILURES drops to 0, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the high arm: leave NIT_STAB_FAC at its default. HI_RESULT_FAILURES drops to 0, so the fixture must go red.
